errors.text_span: 最大的切片位于右侧，为深灰色，标签为“行为”
errors.evidence: In the figure, the large right-side slice labeled “行为” is a darker gray, while the very dark/near-black slice is “要素”; the description misstates the color mapping for the right-side slice.

errors.text_span: 从视觉上看，切片大小大致呈现从“行为”到“状态”“属性”“要素”的递减排列
errors.evidence: The chart shows the slices arranged by size from largest to smaller, but stating a ranked order can be read as a comparative interpretation rather than a strictly necessary visual detail; this is slightly interpretive.
